title: '2 Valid ID's' hits P100 million in box office
summary: The film “2 Valid IDs,” starring Marietta “Pokwang” Subong, Joey Marquez, Meryll Soriano and Zaijian Jaranilla, has earned P100 million at the box office, according to its producers.
